title: UPSC CDS II 2025 OTA Final Result
postName: Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2025 – Officers Training Academy (OTA)
vacancyDetails: Final result of candidates recommended for Officers Training Academy (OTA) under CDS (II) 2025 after SSB interview and medical stages
qualification: Graduation from a recognized university; women and men as per OTA eligibility in CDS notification
ageLimit: As per CDS (II) 2025 notification for OTA course
applicationFee: ₹200 (female / SC / ST candidates exempted as per UPSC rules)
selectionProcess: Written Examination → SSB Interview → Medical Examination → Final Merit for OTA
documentsRequired: Roll number; educational certificates, identity proof; SSB call letter related documents
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsc.gov.in
2. Open Final Results section
3. Download CDS (II) 2025 OTA Final Result PDF
4. Search roll number in recommended list
5. Follow joining instructions from UPSC / Army HQ
shortDescription: UPSC CDS II 2025 OTA Final Result declared. Check recommended candidates list at upsc.gov.in.
content:
The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Final Result for the Officers Training Academy (OTA) course under the Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2025.

Candidates who cleared written exam, SSB interview and medical standards are listed in the final recommended PDF for OTA (Men and Women courses as applicable).

Important points

  • Result is course-wise (OTA)
  • Merit is based on written + SSB as per CDS rules
  • Download only from official UPSC website

Selected candidates should regularly check email and official communications for academy joining formalities.
